name: The dock gate, by day
when: after the Landing, when Ron is leaned on at the gate (Pauline's radio)
offer: Pauline, on the radio: Ron's at the gate, and they've got him in front of the pen.

steps.verb: Stathers's men have Ron cornered in front of the pen

keys.how: go and fight beside him (one of the five heaviest scenes)
send somebody with nerve and stay at the office
stay away and hear it told
